text:
tess: FYI support ticket from ACME — their CSV audit export stops ~30m in and the kms_key_id column is empty for several rows. customer says they need key id for triage. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-842 :eyes:

support-bot: new ticket SEC-842 created by support_agent (org: acme) — logs uploaded to s3://redwood-support/SEC-842/export.log

maya: I looked at the logs — export-job id=job_78a shows repeated `WriteTimeout` after ~20m, then a partial CSV uploaded. JSON export (smaller set) contains `kms.key_id` under event.metadata but CSV flattening drops it.

sanjay: are we flattening nested `event.metadata.kms.key_id` to a CSV column? last schema change (v2) changed flattening rules. can you paste the header?

elaine: header in the file starts with: `ts,actor,action,resource_type,resource_id,details` — no kms column. CSV generator only flattens top-level keys and `metadata` treated as free-text blob. that's why.

kira: product question — do we want KMS key ids in plain export? security/compliance might require it for customer forensic exports but KMS policies might forbid exporting full key ids.

tess: acme claims they explicitly requested full key ids in their compliance export. we should treat this carefully. proposal: default mask `kms.key_id` (last 4 visible) and provide an enterprise-only permission `audit_raw_view` to allow full key ids after legal review.

sanjay: implementation notes: two issues — 1) schema mismatch between CSV v2 and JSON v2, 2) export job queue TTL causing drop for large exports. current job worker TTL=600s and page_size default=1000 which means large orgs time out. we should support streaming and cursored export.

nora: eng-sre here — I can bump worker TTL to 1800s and enable 3 retries for export jobs. will monitor queue backpressure. :thumbsup:

maya: regarding KMS — our telemetry shows key material refs are safe, but customers sometimes need the full key identifier for key owner lookup. KMS policy team prefers not exporting full key ARN by default. we need an audit path: who requested, who approved.

kira: short-term mitigation for ACME: provide an authenticated SFTP with JSON dumps (streaming) and add a note about missing kms ids with steps to request full access. medium-term: RFC for schema v3 that aligns CSV flattening with JSON and adds `kms.key_id_masked` + optional `kms.key_id_full` gated by `audit_raw_view`.

sanjay: sample API call we can add to docs for streaming export:

```
GET /v1/audit/export?org=acme&start=2026-02-01T00:00:00Z&end=2026-02-28T23:59:59Z&format=json&stream=true&page_size=5000
Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>
```
Note: current implementation ignores `stream=true` and returns page-based results — need a runtime change.

elaine: test matrix — e2e should check: csv header columns stable, kms fields present/masked, permission enforcement for `audit_export` vs `audit_raw_view`, and export job retries. I'll draft pytest cases.

tess: can someone own the RFC and the short-term customer fix? I can own the compliance side + escalation with support. need an eng lead and eng-sre owner.

maya: I'll draft RFC for schema v3 and the KMS masking policy. sanjay or nora want to pair on rollout plan?

sanjay: I can own the streaming export runtime changes and the CSV flattening fix. will open PR and include migration guide. planning to spike this week.

nora: I'll do the queue/worker tune and add a temporary S3 JSON dump job for ACME. will post infra runbook for restoring failed exports.

kira: thanks all — product will update support playbook and notify customer we have a mitigation. please tag me on PRs. :raised_hands:

tess: filing follow-ups: SEC-842 (customer remediation), SEC-843 (RFC schema v3), ENG-EXPORT-291 (runtime streaming), SRE-110 (queue TTL).

audit-bot: export-job job_78a status changed -> FAILED (WriteTimeout) at 1768505120

maya: quick note — when we add `audit_raw_view` it must be gated by org admin + legal consent checkbox in console. don't expose it via API without signed agreement.

sanjay: ack. I'll add permission gating and an admin UI toggle behind a feature flag.

kira: actionable items captured. will reticket if we miss anything. :white_check_mark:
